readings: Group signals by RFI status (`rfistat`). Signals whose `rfistat` is NULL form their own group. Average `modindex` for each group, ignoring NULL `modindex` values. The baseline is the overall average `modindex` across all signals, each counted once, ignoring NULL `modindex`. Keep the statuses whose average is strictly above the baseline. For each kept status, show the status, its average `modindex`, the average minus the baseline, and the signed difference (status average minus the mean of the kept statuses' averages). Leave all values unrounded.

Group signals by RFI status (`rfistat`). Signals whose `rfistat` is NULL form their own group. Average `modindex` for each group, ignoring NULL `modindex` values. The baseline is the overall average `modindex` across all signals, each counted once, ignoring NULL `modindex`. Keep the statuses whose average is strictly above the baseline. For each kept status, show the status, its average `modindex`, the average minus the baseline, and the absolute difference (the absolute value of the status average minus the mean of the kept statuses' averages). Leave all values unrounded.
queries:
WITH grp AS (
  SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_mod
  FROM signals
  GROUP BY rfistat
),
base AS (
  SELECT AVG(modindex) AS baseline FROM signals
),
kept AS (
  SELECT g.rfistat, g.avg_mod, b.baseline
  FROM grp g, base b
  WHERE g.avg_mod > b.baseline
)
SELECT
  rfistat,
  avg_mod AS average_modindex,
  avg_mod - baseline AS diff_from_baseline,
  avg_mod - (SELECT AVG(avg_mod) FROM kept) AS signed_diff_from_kept_mean
FROM kept;
WITH g AS (
  SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_mod
  FROM signals
  GROUP BY rfistat
),
b AS (
  SELECT AVG(modindex) AS base FROM signals
),
k AS (
  SELECT g.rfistat, g.avg_mod, b.base
  FROM g, b
  WHERE g.avg_mod > b.base
)
SELECT rfistat,
       avg_mod AS avg_modindex,
       avg_mod - base AS diff_from_baseline,
       ABS(avg_mod - (SELECT AVG(avg_mod) FROM k)) AS abs_diff_from_kept_mean
FROM k;
